decisive_spans.text: Contrast-enhanced CT of the head and temporal bones revealed bilateral osteolysis of the mastoids, superior and lateral semicircular canals, and the right external auditory canal, plus a separate osteolytic lesion in the dorsal left parietal bone

response.rationale: The presence of multiple osteolytic lesions, including in the mastoids, semicircular canals, and a separate lesion in the parietal bone, strongly supports Langerhans cell histiocytosis. Cholesteatoma is less likely as it typically presents with a single lesion and does not explain the parietal bone lesion.
